text:
cecil: Heads-up: launching an Adaptive Soft-Cap (ASC) + Overage Grace Tokens feature on 2027-01-15 00:00 UTC to reduce surprise overage charges for bursty customers. This affects metering, billing API, invoices, and console displays.

cecil: Summary: ASC establishes a short-duration soft cap that adapts to traffic patterns and gives a one-time pool of "grace tokens" (token units applied as a protective buffer) each billing period. Aim is to smooth billing spikes while keeping unit pricing unchanged.

fiona: Finance note: grace tokens show as invoice line `grace_tokens_applied` with a dollar equivalent column `grace_tokens_value`. Auto-applied cap: $750/account/month. Retro adjustment window: 45 days. Credits non-refundable.

harry: Eng note: metering will introduce a new enum header X-Redwood-Cap-Mode: adaptive. We'll emit metrics redwood.billing.asc_active and redwood.billing.grace_tokens_used. No change to per-token rates. CSV sample (invoice v5):

```
account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,asc_active,grace_tokens_applied,grace_tokens_value
```

harry: API: new query param /v1/invoices?include_asc=true to retrieve ASC details; backwards compatible if omitted. Dedicated/reserved contracts are opt-in only (not auto-enrolled).

fiona: UX: console will show a new "soft cap" gauge on the billing page and a tooltip: "Adaptive Soft-Cap protects against short bursts; grace tokens reduce one-off spikes." Banner appears 10 days prior to launch.

cecil: Support FAQ snippets: Q: "Will I be charged extra later?" A: "No, grace tokens are applied immediately to reduce transient overage; any adjustment appears as a single invoice line." Q: "Can I opt out?" A: "Yes — account settings + contact support."

billing-bot: Billing system will record `asc_enrollment` flag per account. CSV will add `asc_enrollment` column for clarity.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-ASC-2027 and added rollout checklist. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-ASC-2027 :white_check_mark:

fiona: Action items: @fiona publish credit rules + sample invoice, @harry publish API header + CSV schema PR, @cecil coordinate banner + executive email for top customers, @docs-bot draft customer-facing FAQ, @ops-bot add monitoring dashboard and weekly rollout report.

harry: I'll post a short migration note and the metrics panels by EOD Thursday.

docs-bot: Draft FAQ will be available in docs/release-notes by Friday for review.

cecil: Thanks all — please flag blockers here. :rocket:
